title: CropProtection
description: Prevents crops from being trampled by players and entities.
body:
About This Mod


### **CropProtection**
> is a simple Fabric mod that prevents crops and farmland from being destroyed when stepped on by players or entities.


I originally made this mod just for playing with friends on our server because there were no available crop protection mods working properly on Minecraft 26.1.2 Fabric at the time.

Since other people may have the same problem, I decided to upload it publicly so anyone can use it on their own worlds or servers.

This is also my first public Minecraft mod project, developed with the help of ChatGPT.

## Features:
1. Prevents crop trampling
2. Works with players and entities
3. Lightweight and server-friendly
4. Designed for modern Fabric versions
